title: The Ledger
text: A room cut square in the ice, and on every wall a table. Twelve columns, one per run, a line for every sol: three numbers, one for each probe. Ours, Kindred's, Engram's. The format is ours. The rounding is ours. Eleven of the columns end on the same line.

lines.text: "Purge complete, run closed. Eleven times, in our words. I've read it eleven times and it doesn't get any shorter."
"Column twelve is open. Its last entry is last night's Biosphere Report: ours, word for word. We're at the top. Accord is always at the top."
"And there's a thirteenth column ruled in beside it. Empty. Somebody is already expecting the next one."

choices.label: Copy all of it
choices.reply: Every column, every sol, every line. It takes the drones four hours. Nothing tries to stop us. Nothing here has ever needed to.

choices.label: Read the last lines again
choices.reply: Purge complete, run closed. Purge complete, run closed. You stop at eleven, because there are only eleven. So far.
